scope: Compliance with all nine prompts in the user-provided PDF; no retroactive claims.

status_semantics.met: Specific document/code requirement checked by stated method; not a global claim of empirical success.
status_semantics.partial: Implemented or partially evidenced; criterion not fully established.
status_semantics.blocked: Requires missing real input, calibration, hardware or external state.
status_semantics.not_met: Requirement or historical deadline was not satisfied; cannot repair history.
